messages:
oliver: Huge thanks to the sec and docs folks for the midnight review — demo-ready because of you. Seriously appreciated. :raised_hands:
tara: big shoutout to @jas for catching the token leak in the config before the call. That was a close one. :exclamation:
jas: phew! found it in a deprecated env var. added a tiny script to scrub creds in the deployment pipeline:
```bash
python tools/scrub_secrets.py --env prod --check-only
```
emily: ops queued a fast rollback plan and helped rehearse the demo flow twice. team rehearsal FTW. also brought bagels. :bagel:
security-bot: [auto] SAST scan completed. New findings: 0 high, 1 medium (deprecated-keys-in-config). See https://security.internal/reports/2152 for details.
ben: donating $40 to the "bagel + thanks" jar and getting @jas a coffee voucher. can someone remind me what flavor the office likes? :coffee:
tara: everything but plain everything. cinnamon and sesame are winners. :yum:
oliver: small follow-up: adding the scrub script to pre-deploy checks and a one-liner to the runbook. will ping the infra channel with PoC tomorrow. thanks again crew — love the quick cross-team energy. :sparkles:
